user.title: Connect Cha Dash
user.description: Make an API token in Cha Dash under Settings → API tokens with the Inbox read scope (inbox.read), then paste it here.

reauth_confirm.title: Cha Dash refused its token
reauth_confirm.description: The API token was revoked or lost the inbox.read scope. Make a new one in Cha Dash under Settings → API tokens and paste it here.

error.invalid_url: Give the address with https://, like https://dash.home.example.
error.invalid_auth: Cha Dash refused that token. It needs the inbox.read scope.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Cha Dash at that address.
error.insecure_url: The token would travel unencrypted. Use https://, or http:// only to a local IP address.

abort.already_configured: This Cha Dash is already set up.
